moved.sentence: **MUST NOT** maintain parallel hand-written token files per platform — they drift.

judged.note: Kept at MUST NOT with the per-platform hand-written scope and the they-drift reason.

moved.sentence: **MUST NOT** let a platform edit propagate "back up" to the source informally; change the source and regenerate.

judged.note: Kept at MUST NOT, with the change-the-source-and-regenerate alternative stated in the same rule.

moved.sentence: **SHOULD NOT** hardcode raw values (hex colors, pixel literals) in feature code when a token exists.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD NOT with the feature-code scope, the hex/pixel examples and the when-a-token-exists condition.

moved.sentence: Run generation as a checked-in, reproducible step (a package script or task), not a one-off manual command.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with the checked-in reproducible step (package script or task) contrasted with a one-off manual command.

moved.sentence: Keep the transform configuration in version control alongside the token source.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD: transform configuration versioned alongside the token source.

moved.sentence: Reach for a managed token pipeline or design-tool sync service only when a measured need justifies it (per YAGNI); a local build step covers most projects.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with the only-on-measured-need condition (per YAGNI) and the local-build-step-covers-most-projects reason.

moved.sentence: Regenerate on **every** token change, and run generation in CI so drift fails fast (per fail-fast).

judged.note: Both halves kept at SHOULD, including every-change emphasis and the CI drift-fails-fast reason (per fail-fast).
Kept at SHOULD: the token source is versioned.

moved.sentence: Treat token releases like any other versioned dependency so consumers can pin and upgrade deliberately.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with the consumers-pin-and-upgrade-deliberately reason.
